text: The dentist is skilled and meticulous. The tooth needed to be extracted, but the dentist filled it and said it would likely last temporarily. It's almost been two years now, and it's still in good condition. No extraction needed.

Two years ago, a male doctor was careless with his instruments and accidentally cut the corner of my mouth. He didn't apologize, only gave me ice to apply.
Most recently, a female doctor was also careless. I don't know if she was tired or what, but she pressed the instrument on the corner of my mouth for so long that my mouth and hand swelled up.
In short, the doctors here are not careful at all. Every time I go, I leave with a cut.

Moved the parking spot to the other side; it's easier to park now.
My regular clinic, the doctor gave good advice.
The receptionist at the counter was very unhelpful and spoke rudely, especially on the phone; their tone was unpleasant. Terrible service.
